title: Large pothole near Katpadi bus stand
description: Big pothole on the main road, two bikes slipped this week.
englishSummary: Large pothole causing two-wheeler accidents near Katpadi bus stand.
priorityReason: Active accident risk on a busy road; 3 reporters.

title: Garbage bin overflowing at Old Bus Stand
description: The bin has not been cleared for 4 days, smell is terrible.
englishSummary: Garbage bin overflowing for 4 days at Old Bus Stand.

title: தெருவிளக்கு எரியவில்லை
description: கோட்டை அருகே உள்ள தெருவிளக்கு ஒரு வாரமாக எரியவில்லை. இரவில் மிகவும் இருட்டாக உள்ளது.
englishSummary: Streetlight near Vellore Fort not working for a week; area very dark at night.

title: Sewage overflowing onto the street
description: Drain is blocked and sewage water is flowing onto the road near the market.
englishSummary: Blocked drain with sewage overflowing onto road near market.
priorityReason: Safety rule: sewage overflow. Public health risk.

title: Water pipe leaking on Sathuvachari main road
description: Water has been leaking from a joint for 3 days, wasting a lot of water.
englishSummary: Water pipe joint leaking for 3 days on Sathuvachari main road.
priorityReason: Continuous water loss; no immediate danger.

title: Live wire hanging from electric pole
description: A wire is hanging low and sparking near the school gate.
englishSummary: Low-hanging sparking live wire near a school gate.
priorityReason: Safety rule: live wire near a school; risk of electrocution.
adminNotes: Line cut and repaired within hours

title: सड़क पर गड्ढा
description: बागायम रोड पर बड़ा गड्ढा है, बारिश में पानी भर जाता है।
englishSummary: Large pothole on Bagayam Road that fills with water in the rain.
priorityReason: Hazard worsens in rain; moderate traffic.

title: Open manhole on footpath
description: Manhole cover missing, very dangerous for children and elderly.
englishSummary: Missing manhole cover on a footpath.
priorityReason: Safety rule: open manhole; fall risk.

title: Streetlights out on entire lane
description: Five consecutive streetlights are off, lane unsafe after dark.
englishSummary: Five consecutive streetlights off in a residential lane.
priorityReason: Multiple lights out; safety risk for residents.

title: Illegal garbage dumping near lake
description: People dump waste near the lake edge daily and it is spreading.
englishSummary: Daily illegal waste dumping at the lake edge.
priorityReason: Ongoing nuisance with no immediate hazard.

title: Road surface broken after pipeline work
description: The road was dug for a pipeline and never repaired properly.
englishSummary: Road left broken after pipeline excavation.

title: குடிநீர் குழாய் கசிவு
description: தெருவில் குடிநீர் குழாயிலிருந்து தண்ணீர் தொடர்ந்து வீணாகிறது.
englishSummary: Drinking water pipe continuously leaking on the street.

title: Overflowing community bins at Katpadi market
description: All bins overflow by noon, stray dogs scatter the waste.
englishSummary: Market bins overflow daily by noon; waste scattered by stray dogs.
priorityReason: Recurring health nuisance in a busy market.

title: Broken footpath slabs
description: Several slabs are cracked and loose, people trip often.
englishSummary: Cracked and loose footpath slabs causing trips.

title: Streetlight flickering at junction
description: The light flickers all night, drivers get distracted.
englishSummary: Flickering streetlight at a busy junction.
